evidence: Running `./run_repro.sh` in a fresh virtualenv consistently fails during `model.fit()` with `tensorflow.python.framework.errors_impl.NotFoundError: Graph execution error` and `codebase/images/definitely_missing.jpg; No such file or directory` at `ReadFile`/`IteratorGetNext`.
steps: Created a local virtualenv with `./setup_env.sh` and installed `tensorflow-cpu==2.17.1`.
Executed `./run_repro.sh` against one real JPEG from `codebase/images/` and one deliberately missing path.
Observed the TensorFlow input pipeline abort with a `NotFoundError` when `tf.io.read_file()` reached the missing image path.
